# Simplify Sales: Unifying Data in Slack


Many sales teams struggle with fragmented tools that force sellers to waste time hunting for information across endless tabs instead of actually selling. Agentforce for Sales addresses these workflow inefficiencies by integrating autonomous AI directly into Slack. Discover how these AI agents proactively scan the web, emails, and calls to identify qualified leads and supercharge your prospecting.
